# News Details


## Farmers National Bank Expands Executive Leadership: Brian Jackson Appointed Chief Operating Officer; Michael Oberhaus Appointed Chief Administrative and Risk Officer


Company Release - 11/10/2026 4:15 PM ET


Download the PDF version PDF Format (opens in new window)


CANFIELD, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Farmers National Bank announces two internal executive leadership changes. Brian Jackson will transition to Chief Operating Officer. Michael Oberhaus will become Chief Administrative and Risk Officer.


Brian Jackson - Chief Operating Officer


Jackson, who currently serves as Chief Information Officer, has been with Farmers since 2009. He brings more than 30 years of information technology experience to this new role. Jackson has been an integral leader of company-wide operational enhancements throughout his tenure with Famers. He is a lifelong Youngstown resident with a degree in Computer Science from Youngstown State University.


Oberhaus joined Farmers in 2015 through the acquisition of First National Bank of Orville. His background includes more than 25 years of banking and financial industry experience, and he has been a certified public accountant since 2012. His expanded role will include leadership oversight of key bank functions while he retains responsibility for compliance and risk management. Oberhaus was a dual major at Marietta College studying industrial engineering and accounting.


Both appointments support Farmers’ continued growth as it reaches 80 branches across Ohio and Pennsylvania and $7 billion in assets following the first-quarter closing of the Middlefield Banc Corp acquisition.


“As Farmers continues to grow, aligning our leadership structure with the needs of a larger organization is essential. Brian and Mike are proven leaders at Farmers, and these appointments build on their experience within our organization,” said Kevin Helmick, President and Chief Executive Officer.


**About Farmers National Banc Corp.**


Founded in 1887, Farmers National Banc Corp. is a diversified financial services company headquartered in Canfield, Ohio, with $7.1 billion in banking assets. Farmers National Banc Corp.’s wholly owned subsidiaries are comprised of The Farmers National Bank of Canfield, a full-service national bank engaged in commercial and retail banking with 80 banking locations in Ohio and western Pennsylvania, and Farmers Trust Company, which operates trust offices and offers services in the same geographic markets. Total wealth management assets under care at September 30, 2026, are $5.2 billion. Farmers National Insurance LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of The Farmers National Bank of Canfield, offers a variety of insurance products.
